It notes that the setting of linear regression with general covariances is generic enough and only offers a possibility that 'one could back up the claim with experimental validation on real datasets', rather than directing the authors to conduct specific simulation studies. This is an explicit action (adding experimental validation), but it is vague on how to execute it: it does not specify which real datasets, what experiments, or how the validation should be designed. Therefore, the authors can identify what general action to take, but they do not know exactly how to implement it.
